tasks.short: Teach and supervise staff in anesthesia practices.

steps.what: Select approved anesthesia teaching material for the learner's competence gap
Explain and demonstrate anesthesia practices under the supervising clinician's protocols
Observe staff practice, correct errors and assess competence
Draft learner completion and supervision notes
Check the final learner assessment and authorize its recording
Post the approved assessment to the learner's training record

tasks.design: Configure approved module bundles and competency forms in {LMS}, linked to the current anesthesia procedures in {DOCS}. The assistant chooses and adapts the bundle, teaches and assesses in person, then approves the complete learner record before posting; no system certifies clinical competence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Teaching preparation and competency records are often maintained separately.
tasks.enabler_now: Native module bundles can reuse approved material and prefill learner and procedure identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Recognizing unsafe technique and deciding whether practice is sufficient.
tasks.human_edge: Intervene safely during practice and tailor explanations to the learner.

ambition.what: Offer a short refresher for staff returning to anesthesia work after extended absence.

tasks.altitude: Less time rebuilding teaching packs, with the same bedside supervision and competence decision rights.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: learning systems can reuse approved modules and structured competency forms; clinical competence assessment stays human.

assumptions: Boundary is assistant preparation, teaching, assessment and learner documentation. Learner practice and supervising clinician work are existing outside labour and receive no saving or new transfer.

Training administrator maintains approved modules with procedure ID, revision, learning objective and competence criterion. The existing learner record provides learner ID and past completions. s1 selects the bundle; missing material is prepared manually within s1.

s3 produces observed skill, assessment date, result and remediation needs. s4 captures those observations manually; only repeated identifiers and criterion headings are prefilled. No competence outcome is inferred.
First test native {LMS} forms and bundles. The proposed shares are unmeasured typical-work estimates, and existing automatic prefills must be removed from the saving baseline.
Clinical equipment use is teaching activity, not automated clinical treatment. Local scope and supervision rules remain in force.
research_questions: Does bundle reuse reduce preparation without hiding obsolete procedures?

already_counted.description: Verify final competency statements before posting

incremental.description: Check module links and forms after procedure revisions

approvals.approved_version: Final learner record, competence outcome and remediation text approved in s5; edits invalidate approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central net 10%: 6 preparation hours, 3 record drafting hours and 2 posting hours saved, less 1 upkeep. Low assumes bundles suit only a quarter of sessions and most narrative capture stays manual. No reduction in instruction or observation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Attend professional activities and maintain current anesthesiology knowledge.

steps.what: Choose relevant accredited learning from professional programs and current practice needs
Participate in seminars, practical workshops and professional discussion
Prepare the professional learning log and personal practice reflection
Verify the final learning log and save the personal attestation

tasks.design: Use a native {LMS} completion form that reuses the selected activity metadata and attaches the attendance certificate. The assistant enters the learning reflection and personally verifies and saves the final log; attendance, participation and educational judgement keep their full time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Learning activity details get retyped into the professional log.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms can reuse enrolled activity metadata without generating clinical advice.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding whether new research should change practice and learning hands-on skills.
tasks.human_edge: Question presenters and evaluate applicability to local anesthesia practice.
tasks.altitude: Little changes beyond less repeated log entry. Professional development and clinical authority stay the same.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a learning log can reuse course metadata; this does not substitute for participation or professional reflection.

assumptions: Boundary includes choosing, attending and recording learning, not travel or purchasing course places. This design does not add booking or payment automation.

The course catalogue producer supplies activity ID, title, provider, date and stated credits. The provider supplies the attendance certificate at s2. The assistant confirms actual attendance and writes reflection in s3; unsupported credits are entered manually.
The estimated saving applies only where today's professional log repeats activity fields. If native reuse already exists, set that saving to zero. No new provider capture is required.
Native {LMS} configuration is tested first. s4 retains all final review and attestation time, bound to the completed s3 draft.
unknowns: Whether staff maintain a separate learning log
research_questions: How much of log entry is repeat metadata rather than reflection?

incremental.description: Check course field mappings and handle catalogue changes

approvals.approved_version: Completed learning log and certificate reviewed immediately before the assistant saves that exact revision

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central net 3%: half of 7 log-entry hours removed, less 0.5 upkeep. Low assumes fewer than one in six activities has reusable metadata, consuming the saving in upkeep. Attendance and attestation do not shrink.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Protect clinical teaching and professional learning while reducing repeated learning-record entry.
role.ambitious_version: Offer targeted return-to-practice refreshers while preserving supervised clinical instruction.
